content: For the treatment of vasomotor symptoms and vulvar or vaginal atrophy, patients should be prescribed the lowest effective dose. Typically, women are initiated on a daily dose of 0.3 mg/1.5 mg of PREMPRO. Adjustments to the dosage may be made based on the individual patient’s response to the treatment. If bleeding or spotting persists as an issue, after conducting an appropriate evaluation, the healthcare provider should consider modifying the dose. For the prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis, patients should also be treated with the lowest effective dose. The standard starting dose is 0.3 mg/1.5 mg of PREMPRO daily. Dosage adjustments may be necessary depending on the patient’s clinical response and bone mineral density results. If bleeding or spotting remains problematic, after proper evaluation, the dose may need to be altered. For patients on PREMPHASE therapy, the regimen involves two distinct tablets. From days 1 through 14 of the cycle, patients should take one maroon tablet containing 0.625 mg of Premarin daily. From days 15 through 28, patients should take one light-blue tablet daily, which contains 0.625 mg of conjugated estrogens and 5 mg of medroxyprogesterone acetate.
